split: official TRAIN only; existing five grouped folds

feature_roles.state: MiniLM masked-mean feature of the two supplied support facts in source order
feature_roles.criterion: MiniLM masked-mean feature of the QASC question
feature_roles.options: one MiniLM masked-mean feature per supplied answer option in supplied order

readout.checkpoint_rule: fixed epoch 8 endpoint; no held-fold checkpoint selection

controls: same checkpoint with criterion mask absent
option permutation invariance on fixed held-fold rows
claim_scope: task-specific QASC text Decision development cross-validation; not multimodal, broad text, or product quality
